add_executable(nas_pdn_reject_test nas_pdn_reject_test.cc)
target_compile_definitions(nas_pdn_reject_test PRIVATE ASSERTS_ENABLED)
target_link_libraries(nas_pdn_reject_test
  srsepc_mme
  s1ap_asn1
  srsran_asn1
  srsran_common
  srslog
  support
  ${CMAKE_THREAD_LIBS_INIT}
  ${SEC_LIBRARIES}
  ${SCTP_LIBRARIES})
add_lte_test(nas_pdn_reject_test nas_pdn_reject_test)

if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ipv4v6_fallback_test.cc")
  add_executable(ipv4v6_fallback_test ipv4v6_fallback_test.cc)
  target_link_libraries(ipv4v6_fallback_test
    srsepc_mme

    srslog

    ${SEC_LIBRARIES}

foreach(test_name strict_apn_test spgw_session_safety_test ue_snapshot_test restricted_apn_access_test restricted_mme_lifecycle_test)
  add_executable(${test_name} ${test_name}.cc)
  target_compile_definitions(${test_name} PRIVATE ASSERTS_ENABLED)
  target_link_libraries(${test_name} srsepc_mme srsepc_hss srsepc_sgw srsran_gtpu s1ap_asn1 srsran_asn1
    srsran_common srslog support ${CMAKE_THREAD_LIBS_INIT} ${SEC_LIBRARIES} ${SCTP_LIBRARIES})
  add_lte_test(${test_name} ${test_name})
endforeach()
